sn7.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn7.3:1.3: Bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo kira samaṇassa Gotamassa santike agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajito ti || || 3. Kupito anattamano yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosati paribhāsati || || 4.
sn7.3:1.5: Atha kho asurindaka-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.3:1.6: Jito si samaṇa || jito si samaṇā ti || || 6.
sn7.3:6.1: Evaṃ vutte asurindaka-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.3:6.2: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama || pa ||
sn7.3:6.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosī ti || || 1.
